_doc: Coverage policy enforced by the PR policy workflow (tests-policy check) via scripts/coverage_tools.py gate. Scope: main.lua, weread/**/*.lua, integrations/**/*.lua; spec/, scripts/ and fixtures never count. 'combined' = unit specs + emulator scenarios (LuaCov in the real KOReader app). Targets turn blocking on their date; before it they are report-only. Effective target = max(configured, day-one combined baseline). The ratchet compares a PR with main's latest baseline on the 'coverage' branch (falls back to day_one_baseline).
